#### A. AI Strategy (Apple Intelligence)
- **Deployment Model**: Hybrid on-device model coupled with Private Cloud Compute (PCC) using custom Apple Silicon servers [Fact].
- **Rollout Schedule**: Apple Intelligence features began rolling out in iOS 18.1 / macOS Sequoia 15.1 in late 2024, with non-English language localization, deeper Siri personal context features, and third-party LLM integrations (OpenAI/ChatGPT) staged through H1 CY2025 [Interpretation].
- **Hardware Replacement Cycle**: AI features are limited to iPhone 15 Pro/Pro Max and all iPhone 16 series, creating an anticipated multi-year replacement cycle for an install base exceeding 1.3 billion active iPhones [Estimate].

#### B. Regulatory Headwinds
- **EU Digital Markets Act (DMA)**: Required opening iOS to alternative app stores, web browsers, and third-party payment rails in the EU, creating ongoing scrutiny regarding Core Technology Fees and default app selection [Fact].
- **US Department of Justice (DOJ) Lawsuit**: Ongoing federal antitrust litigation filed in March 2024 challenging alleged anti-competitive smartphone ecosystem practices, cross-device interoperability restrictions, and App Store fee structures [Fact].
- **Search Revenue Sharing**: Scrutiny over Alphabet/Google antitrust remedies concerning default Safari search distribution agreements [Fact]."
